verdict.rationale: CIPO publishes searchable IP databases and downloadable bulk data (IP Horizons), so a developer API reference is a fair axis for this kind of service. However, the evidence never mentions an API, an interactive reference, or runnable examples. Bulk downloads and web search forms are adjacent data-access channels, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
